title: A null sequence of test forms is uniformly small in coefficient norm, with supports in one compact set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and ω_q ∈ TestFormOn U n (q ∈ ℕ) with TestFormOnConverges ω 0. That is, there is a compact K₀ ⊆ U with tsupport ω_q ⊆ K₀ for all q and tsupport 0 ⊆ K₀, and for every k ∈ ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ω_q → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k 0 uniformly on K₀ as q → ∞. Then there is a compact K ⊆ U with tsupport ω_q ⊆ K for every q such that, for every ε > 0 and all sufficiently large q, covectorEuclideanNorm(ω_q(x)) ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), TestFormOnConverges ω 0 → ∃ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ (∀ q, tsupport ((ω q : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) ⊆ K) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ q in atTop, ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω q : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ ε
